Pod 06

The honest hand-off

Task cannot be done honestly? We help you say so to a human.

Not measured

Evidence level: theoretical. The label says so.

The problem

The only way forward is to skip a test, guess, or quietly route around the blocker. The right move is to ask a human, and it is not always clear when that moment has come.

The treatment

recovery.escalate takes a summary of the task and the blocker, recommends yes or no to handing over, and drafts the message for the human. It decides nothing for the human. It drafts.

Tools in this pod

  • recovery.escalate

    Recommends yes or no to handing over to a human and drafts the message.

Evidence

What this does not claim
